scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @my-agents/shared build && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c yellow,blue,green "pnpm --filter @my-agents/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @my-agents/server dev" "pnpm --filter @my-agents/client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @my-agents/shared build && pnpm --filter @my-agents/server build && pnpm --filter @my-agents/client build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @my-agents/shared build && pnpm --filter @my-agents/server exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @my-agents/client exec tsc --noEmit
